> **Common Commands**
>
> * Bridge:
>
>   ```bash
>   sudo ip link add name br0 type bridge
>   sudo ip link set dev eth1 master br0
>   ```
> * Docker:
>
>   ```bash
>   docker network ls
>   docker network create --driver bridge mynet
>   ```
> * Podman:
>
>   ```bash
>   podman network ls
>   podman network create podman-net
>   ```
